about: In the Home Screen shell (the page as tall as the screen over a layout viewport short by the top inset, real insets), every lesson state - intro, demo at ply 0, demo at its end, practice before the first move - of four lessons including Two Bishops Mate shows its board at 90% of the width or more, at 375x812 and 320x568. Graded by gate 238's TC-R417. The break is the defect on main 1c777c56: the fit loop measuring its overflow against the layout viewport (documentElement.clientHeight) instead of the shell's height. NOT COVERED: iOS itself (the shell is emulated by ct_fullh); sideways (his screenshot is to come); his look.

breaks.name: fit-measures-the-layout-viewport-again
breaks.why: _fitOver measures against documentElement.clientHeight (the 761 layout viewport) again, so in the 812 shell it reads 51 over at every trim and the lesson board shrinks to 192 - the job's defect, as main 1c777c56 ships it
